en.headline: Transport Department orders probe after truck crash snarls airport link
en.dek: A medium goods vehicle overturned on Cheung Tsing Highway in Tsing Yi during the Thursday evening rush hour, causing more than three hours of gridlock on the route to the airport.
body: The Transport Department has instructed the operator of the Tsing Ma Control Area to investigate a collision that left a medium goods vehicle overturned on Cheung Tsing Highway in Tsing Yi and paralysed traffic on the airport link for more than three hours during Thursday's evening peak.

Police and rescue crews were alerted at about 7.36 pm. The overturned truck blocked multiple lanes. Drivers of the two vehicles involved were taken to Princess Margaret Hospital for treatment. Social media reports described buses trapped inside Cheung Tsing Tunnel and delays of three-and-a-half to four hours for motorists heading to Hong Kong International Airport, Kowloon and Hong Kong Island.

The operator dispatched light and heavy-duty rescue vehicles and cooperated with police. The Transport Department has required a detailed report with recommendations for improvement. A lawmaker called for a review of operator contracts, penalty mechanisms and contingency guidelines for traffic flow and ventilation on the vital corridor.

zh.headline: 長青公路貨車翻側堵塞機場通道 運輸署要求調查
zh.dek: 一輛中型貨車星期四晚在青衣長青公路翻側，導致往機場方向交通癱瘓逾三小時，運輸署已要求青馬管制區營辦商提交報告。
body: 運輸署已指示青馬管制區營辦商就星期四晚一宗導致中型貨車翻側的車禍展開調查。事故發生於青衣長青公路，造成往機場方向交通癱瘓逾三小時。
警方及救援人員約晚上七時三十六分接報。翻側貨車堵塞多條行車線，兩名司機送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。社交平台有乘客指巴士困於長青隧道內，往機場、九龍及港島方向的車程延誤三個半至四小時。
營辦商派出輕型及重型救援車輛，並與警方合作。運輸署要求提交詳細報告及改善建議。有立法會議員促請檢討營辦商合約、罰則機制，以及制訂交通疏導與通風應變指引。
